content:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: SEV2 alert — sudden spike in 5xxs for cross-region requests (eu-west -> us-east). Automated fallback to backup model attempted and failed for some flows. Root ts 2475001234
sam: seeing ~4% error rate on edge-proxy for eu-west clients, latency also up ~300ms for affected subset
jen: confirmed in dashboards — error spike started ~2m ago, traces show requests hitting us-east-k8s pool and timing out at backend service (connection resets)
netops: hitting routing policy logs — multiple `pin_evaluator` entries marking sessions as P1 pinned to us-east despite client geos in eu-west. suspicious
ops-pager: paging oncall now (maria oncall). forwarding alerts + relevant traces
oncall-bot: maria accepted the page — joining in 30s
maria: on it. quick ask: can someone `dig` the steering DNS for eu-west and paste TTLs?
sam: ran `dig +short steering.redwood.internal A @dns1` — returns us-east ip pairs, TTL 30s. also `curl -I` against gw shows `X-Region: us-east` for some eu-west UAs
jen: grabbing route policy commit history — last change to latency-steer rules 10m ago (auto-suggest optimizer applied new thresholds)
netops: looks like optimizer lowered latency sensitivity so fallback to nearest-region logic kicked in but pin cache wasn't cleared; combined with a small bug in pin evaluator that treats a failed fallback as a sticky pin -> requests kept going to us-east
maria: mitigation plan: 1) toggle latency-steer off for eu-west 2) flush pin cache 3) temporarily increase steering TTL so DNS shifts are stable 4) monitor 5xx rate. who can flip the toggle?
sam: I can flip the toggle in <2m. command: `curl -X POST https://console.redwood/api/steering/toggle -d '{"region":"eu-west","enabled":false}'` — will post logs here
jen: I'll run the cache flush: `redis-cli -h pins-cache del "route_pins:eu-west:*"` then tail the logs
netops: I'll raise DNS TTL to 300s for steering (patching dns-config) to avoid oscillation while fix propagates
ops-pager: executing > toggle off (sam) ; flush (jen) ; dns change (netops). notify SRE if we see customer impact >5%
sam: toggle off done — console returns 200 OK, steering.enabled=false
jen: flush done: deleted ~1200 keys, tail shows subsequent requests now annotated `X-Region: eu-west`
netops: DNS TTL bumped to 300s, change pushed to secondary -> propagation within ~2m
maria: good — errors dropping, 5xxs down to ~0.6% now. latency back to baseline for most flows. continuing to monitor for 10m
customer-success: heads-up: we saw two enterprise customers ping about slow responses earlier. doing outreach to affected customers and noting mitigation steps. CC legal for any required notices
maria: quick customer impact note: estimated 4% of cross-region traffic impacted, concentrated on long-prompt interactive sessions; no data loss observed. potential SLA latency blips for 3 customers with heavy traffic.
ops-pager: marking incident as mitigated (hotfix toggled). opening incident channel for postmortem: #incident-2475001234-postmortem. assign to eng-runtime and eng-ml to triage pin_evaluator bug and optimizer thresholds
jen: filing a blameless bug: `ENG-4821` — pin cache eviction race + optimizer threshold change interaction. will include trace samples and redis keys we flushed
maria: oncall handoff to nights @sam in 20m. leave monitoring watches for next 2h. If errors creep above 1% re-open paging
incident-bot: :white_check_mark: Incident status updated: mitigated -> monitoring. severity downgraded to SEV3. Thread closed at 2475001544
